decisions.decision: Turf vs sod field item: no action taken; information received for committee and district review, with a recommendation and vote to come at future meetings.

decisions.decision: Site Digital Sign deferred to the March 2016 meeting for discussion.
decisions.quote: this item will be discussed at the march 2016 meeting.

decisions.decision: Added Cooling to the Building deferred to the March 2016 meeting; Tappe is working on system design.

decisions.quote: the school will be looking to alternated options for the display of archives and alternate financing means should these means be available in the future.
